t: AWS IAM streamlines assignment of IAM roles to workforce users with account access manager
x: Assign IAM roles in AWS accounts to IAM Identity Center users and groups.

t: AWS Secrets Manager adds managed external secrets support for Jenkins and SonarQube
x: Automatic rotation of Jenkins API tokens and SonarQube tokens.

t: AWS IAM now provides role manager to set up IAM roles automatically
x: GA of role manager: creates or reuses the default IAM roles services need during console setup.

t: Amazon Quick adds deny by default for custom permissions
x: Amazon Quick custom permissions now include deny by default, a governance setting that automatically restricts new AI capabilities before they reach users.

t: AWS Certificate Manager supports switching from e-mail to DNS validation
x: Change validation to DNS without reissuing the certificate or changing its ARN.

t: Amazon S3 adds additional policy details to access denied error messages
x: Amazon S3 now includes the specific AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) and AWS Organizations policy Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in HTTP 403 Access Denied error messages for same-account and same-organization…

t: AWS Network Firewall Now Supports Stateful Rule Hit Counts
x: Hit counts per stateful rule to tune policies.

t: AWS IAM identity federation to external services is now available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud Region
x: Workloads authenticate to external services with short-lived JWTs.

t: IAM Policy Autopilot now supports Terraform plan files
x: IAM Policy Autopilot can now generate baseline IAM policies directly from a Terraform plan file.

t: AWS IAM now supports 20 managed policies per role by default
x: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) has increased the default quota for managed policies per role from 10 to 20.

t: AWS Security Agent (now part of AWS Continuum) now supports budget controls and finding revalidation
x: AWS Security Agent (now part of AWS Continuum) has a on-demand penetration testing service that uses an AI agent to autonomously test web applications for vulnerabilities, billing based on cumulative task hours…

t: Amazon DynamoDB Streams now supports attribute-based access control
x: Amazon DynamoDB Streams now supports attribute-based access control (ABAC), enabling you to use tag-based conditions in your Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies to control access to your data streams.

t: Amazon SageMaker notebooks now support trusted identity propagation
x: Per-user access control through Lake Formation for Athena, Redshift and EMR Serverless.

t: Amazon CloudFront now supports Origin Access Control (OAC) for Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points
x: Starting today, customers can protect their origins using Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points (MRAP) by using CloudFront Origin Access Control (OAC) to only allow access from designated CloudFront distributions.

t: Amazon EKS now supports certificate authority (CA) rotation with automated lifecycle management
x: Today, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) announced certificate authority (CA) rotation, enabling customers to rotate their cluster's CA through a managed lifecycle with automated safeguards.

t: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB now supports customer managed keys
x: Customer managed keys for InfluxDB 2 instances, read replicas and InfluxDB 3 clusters.

t: Amazon EKS now supports multiple external OIDC identity providers per cluster
x: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) now supports multiple external OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity providers per cluster.

t: SageMaker MLflow now supports customer managed keys
x: MLflow data encrypted with customer managed KMS keys.

t: AWS Lambda functions now support full IAM resource-based policies
x: AWS Lambda functions now support full Identity and Access Management (IAM) resource-based policies, enabling platform admins and security teams to define granular access permissions using the full capabilities of AWS…

t: AWS Secrets Manager adds managed external secrets support for Cisco Security Platform and Netskope
x: Automatic rotation of Cisco and Netskope credentials without custom code.

t: Amazon GameLift Servers enhanced DDoS Protection now available
x: Network and transport layer DDoS protection for game servers, no configuration.

t: IAM Roles Anywhere now provides a Java plugin for the AWS SDK
x: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) Roles Anywhere now provides a plugin for the AWS SDK for Java v2 that enables workloads running outside of AWS to obtain temporary AWS credentials directly within the Java…

t: AWS Backup adds cross-Region backup copy and logically air-gapped vault support for Amazon DocumentDB in nine additional AWS Regions
x: AWS Backup now supports copying Amazon DocumentDB backups across AWS Regions and storing them in logically air-gapped vaults in nine additional AWS Regions: Asia Pacific (Hong Kong, Jakarta, Melbourne, Osaka), Europe…

t: Amazon Cognito adds admin API operation to reset user TOTP configurations
x: Amazon Cognito now provides a new admin API operation to reset a user's time-based one-time Password (TOTP) multi-factor authentication (MFA) configuration.

t: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now supports fine-grained access control
x: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now supports fine-grained access control (FGAC), enabling you to enforce per-user and per-tenant memory isolation through AgentCore Gateway without building custom authorization logic.

t: AWS Agent Registry for centralized agent discovery and governance is now generally available
x: GA of a governed catalog of agents, tools, skills and MCP servers.

t: AWS Workload Credentials Provider is now available as a one-click install for Linux and Windows
x: Single-command install of AWCP for local secret caching.

t: Amazon Cognito now supports machine-to-machine authorization without a user pool domain
x: Amazon Cognito now supports the GetClientToken API operation, enabling app clients to obtain access tokens for machine-to-machine (M2M) authorization directly through the AWS SDK, CLI, or API — without configuring a…

t: Amazon Redshift now supports AWS IAM Identity Center authentication with enhanced VPC routing
x: SSO to Redshift with enhanced VPC routing; traffic stays on the AWS network.

t: Automated Security Response on AWS adds AI Toolkit for custom remediations
x: ASR adds an AI Toolkit for custom remediations and auto-remediation of Inspector, GuardDuty and Macie findings.

t: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity now offers a managed consent portal
x: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity now offers a managed consent portal that eliminates the need for custom OAuth callback infrastructure when connecting agents to third-party tools and services.

t: AWS Config now supports 60 new resource types
x: 60 new resource types including Bedrock, EC2, SageMaker and Organizations.

t: Amazon S3 now supports PrivateLink for FIPS endpoints
x: Amazon S3 now supports AWS PrivateLink for endpoints that have been validated under the Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) 140-3 program.

t: Amazon SES now supports S/MIME email signing
x: S/MIME signatures let recipients verify sender and message integrity.

t: AWS Transfer Family SFTP Connectors now support continuing file transfers during credential rotation
x: Transfers keep running while Secrets Manager rotates SFTP credentials.

t: Amazon GuardDuty adds optional threat detection rules
x: Library of 35 opt-in Custom Detection Rules for CloudTrail management events, 26 finding types mapped to 10 MITRE ATT&CK tactics.

t: Amazon API Gateway now supports mutual TLS for backend integrations
x: REST APIs present an ACM certificate to backends for mTLS.

t: Amazon S3 Object Lock now supports variable retention with event holds
x: WORM retention that starts at a future event such as a contract closing.

t: AWS Private CA EKS add-on and Connector for AD now available in AWS GovCloud (US)
x: Kubernetes and Active Directory certificate connectors in GovCloud.

t: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base adds APIs and console support for debugging document-level access control
x: AWS announces the CheckIngestedDocumentAcl and GetIngestedDocumentAcl APIs for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base, giving customers a self-service way to debug document access issues and audit document-level…

t: Amazon EBS Volume Clones now supports copying volumes across accounts
x: Cross-account EBS volume copy with re-encryption under a KMS key in the target account.

t: Amazon ECS expands IAM condition key support for RunTask and StartTask APIs
x: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) now supports the IAM condition keys for CPU and memory resources on the RunTask and StartTask APIs.

t: AWS improves regional resiliency for root user sign-in
x: Root sign-in served from three US Regions instead of only N. Virginia.

t: AWS STS simplifies session token size limits and adds session token size monitoring
x: Single 4,096-byte session token limit plus size monitoring.

t: Analyze your CloudTrail events using natural language in Amazon Q Console
x: Investigate account activity in natural language through Amazon Q.

t: AWS Continuum now supports credential testing and accessible domain suggestions
x: AWS Continuum for penetration testing is a frontier agent that proactively secures applications throughout the development lifecycle by offering on-demand, customized penetration testing with real exploitability testing.

t: AWS PrivateLink announces Tunnel Endpoints to access network segments
x: AWS PrivateLink customers can now use VPC endpoint to privately and securely access network segments in another VPC/account.

t: AWS Security Hub AI Inventory adds Azure self-hosted instance support
x: AI Inventory discovers AI assets on self-hosted Microsoft Azure instances.

t: AWS Network Security Manager is now generally available in US East (N. Virginia) Region
x: GA of central policy deployment for WAF and Shield Advanced, Network Firewall to follow.

t: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL now supports post-quantum TLS key exchange
x: Starting today, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL introduces support for post-quantum TLS (PQ-TLS) key exchange, providing you with post-quantum cryptography options for encrypting your data in-transit.

t: AWS IAM outbound identity federation now supports interface VPC endpoints for OIDC discovery
x: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) outbound identity federation now supports Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) endpoints for the OpenID Connect (OIDC) discovery APIs.

t: Amazon Transcribe adds customer-managed KMS keys for custom resources
x: Custom vocabularies, filters and language models encrypted with customer managed keys.

t: AWS Backup adds logically air-gapped vault support for Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP
x: AWS Backup logically air-gapped vault now supports Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP.

t: Amazon Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall support for Palo Alto Networks Advanced DNS Security is now Generally Available
x: PANW Advanced DNS Security rules on DNS Firewall, GA in 32 Regions, no separate firewalls or VPC changes.

t: AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing now available in 6 additional Regions
x: Managed pentesting of web apps and APIs now in Seoul, Montreal, London, Columbus, Paris and Stockholm.

t: AWS IAM Identity Center Identity Store APIs now accept resource ARNs in addition to resource IDs
x: ARNs accepted wherever Identity Store APIs took resource IDs; additive and backward compatible.

t: AWS accounts now support phone number verification
x: Primary contact phone verified by SMS OTP in the console or via SendPhoneNumberVerification / VerifyPhoneNumber APIs.

t: Amazon Kinesis Video Streams now supports VPC endpoints with AWS PrivateLink
x: Control plane, ingestion and playback over interface VPC endpoints, no internet gateway or NAT.

t: Amazon Redshift simplifies access to secure logging with federated permissions
x: New DEBUG permission lets chosen identities see unredacted secure logging records under fine-grained access control.

t: Uncover blind spots in AWS data plane operations with CloudTrail Event Coverage
x: Console view of which services and resource types have data event logging enabled, at account and org level.

t: AWS IAM Identity Center extends multi-Region support to more AWS Regions
x: Replication now reaches opt-in Regions and Regions within GovCloud (US) and China.

t: AWS Security Hub introduces remediation plans to prioritize and fix security exposures
x: Groups exposure findings that share a root cause so one fix resolves or reduces many exposures.

t: Amazon GuardDuty now supports centralized management using AWS Organizations declarative policies
x: Org policy enables GuardDuty in every account and Region; cannot be overridden from console or API.

t: Amazon S3 Object Lock variable retention with event holds is now available in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
x: Event-based WORM retention now in GovCloud (US-East) and GovCloud (US-West).

t: Announcing DNS analytics and insights for Route 53 Global Resolver and DNS Firewall
x: CloudWatch Metrics and Contributor Insights on DNS query logs, with a new Analytics tab.

t: Improve your secrets security posture with actionable recommendations in the AWS Secrets Manager console
x: Recommended Actions in the console: configure rotation, switch to customer managed keys, fix configuration.

t: AgentCore Gateway supports private TLS certificates for VPC endpoints
x: Private-CA-signed certificates on MCP, OpenAPI and HTTP proxy targets, no intermediate ALB.

t: GuardDuty Runtime Monitoring is now included in the AWS Security Hub Threat Analytics plan
x: Runtime Monitoring for EC2, EKS and ECS on Fargate now billed under Security Hub Threat Analytics; no reconfiguration.

t: AWS Client VPN now supports device posture assessment
x: CrowdStrike, Jamf or JumpCloud signals evaluated with Cedar policies; non-compliant sessions disconnected; monitoring-only mode.

t: AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing now supports continuous penetration testing integrated directly into your CI/CD pipeline
x: Public preview: pentest at deploy time, findings in pipeline output, fixes re-tested automatically.

t: AWS Control Tower AFT now supports plan-only customization runs
x: Run a Terraform plan for global and account customizations without applying changes.

t: AWS IAM Identity Center now supports network access controls for Identity Store
x: Restrict the Identity Store API to VPC endpoints, source VPCs or IP ranges, and the SCIM API to IP ranges. Off by default.

t: AWS Private CA now provides detailed certificate issuance logs
x: New CloudTrail event with full certificate content, issuing CA, requester and status for every issuance, failed ones included.

t: AWS Certificate Manager now supports ACME issuance through AWS PrivateLink
x: Request and renew public TLS certificates over a VPC interface endpoint, with no ACME client changes.

t: AWS Config now supports 77 new resource types
x: 77 resource types added, including Identity Center applications and GuardDuty entity sets; tracked automatically when recording all types.

t: AWS Network Firewall adds wildcard support for container attribute filters
x: Wildcard patterns such as app=payments-* match every variant of an EKS or ECS workload in one rule.

t: Amazon GuardDuty RDS Protection now detects data exfiltration and destruction in Aurora and RDS databases
x: Query-pattern anomaly detection for Aurora PostgreSQL and RDS for PostgreSQL, no agents; 30-day free trial.

t: AWS Lambda supports OAuth authentication for self-managed Apache Kafka event sources
x: Kafka event source mappings authenticate through an enterprise identity provider such as Cognito or Okta.

t: AWS Security Hub now exports findings to S3 in CSV or JSON format
x: On-demand export from every findings page to your S3 bucket, in CSV or OCSF JSON.
